September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 730)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata declarations, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on September 4 across six consecutive years of The Adventures of Superman (1941–1950) starring Clayton "Bud" Collyer and Michael Fitzmaurice for Kellogg's Pep, spanning classic story arcs against subterranean mad scientists, wartime munitions saboteurs, airborne nerve-gas rockets, postwar black-market cartels, corrupt political machines, and Grand Prix auto-racing racketeers, Clayton "Bud" Collyer (1941, 1942, 1944, 1945, 1946) and Michael Fitzmaurice (1950):
